title: Questions 168-171 refer to the following article.
passage_1:
Northbank Robotics to Reshape Dundee with New Research Campus

DUNDEE (14 March)—Northbank Robotics, a leading engineering group, has formally announced its plan to build a large research and manufacturing campus in Dundee. – [1] –. According to Priya Anand, chief executive of Northbank Robotics, the company will convert a 60-acre vacant dockyard site along the river, turning it into an advanced facility with high-precision assembly halls and extensive outdoor testing grounds.

– [2] –. “For years, our city has watched its most capable engineering graduates leave for work elsewhere,” Councillor Ian Hearne said. “This campus will create plentiful openings in engineering and design, helping us keep our recent graduates.” – [3] –.

In addition, the influx of technical staff and the launch of public tours of the campus are expected to boost local tourism and revitalise the regional economy. Recruitment for positions in set construction, lighting technology, and administration is scheduled to start in November. – [4] –.
